items.text: How Is the Diploma How is the diploma or ITI seat filled? Usually through the state technical education board or the state skill department, by merit or a test. Dates and cut-offs differ every year.

items.heading: Which Subject Groups Does
items.text: Which subject groups does the school actually offer? Not every school runs PCMB, commerce with Maths or a given arts combination, and many set their own minimum marks.

items.heading: Is the Institute Approved,
items.text: Is the institute approved, and what is the total fee? Ask for the approval proof and the full fee list before paying anything.

items.heading: What Did Last Year's Students
items.text: What did last year's students do next? Ask for the number who found work, joined apprenticeship training or took lateral entry.

items.heading: Does the Degree You May
items.text: Does the degree you may want accept this certificate? This matters most for open schooling and for lateral entry, where rules sit with the state and the college.
